title: Fourier expansion of a translated subset density
statement: Let $n\geq0$, let $f:(\mathbb F_2)^n\to\mathbb R$, let $H$ be a linear subspace of $(\mathbb F_2)^n$, and let $z\in(\mathbb F_2)^n$. The uniform inner product of the density that is uniform on $H$ with the translate $x\mapsto f(x+z)$ equals $\sum_{\gamma\in H^\perp}\chi_\gamma(z)\,\widehat f(\gamma)$, where $H^\perp$ is the orthogonal subspace for the standard dot product, $\chi_\gamma$ is the corresponding Walsh character, and $\widehat f(\gamma)$ is the Fourier coefficient of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $H$ is a linear subspace of $(\mathbb F_2)^n$
